basic_details.short_information: Oil India Limited (OIL), a Maharatna Public Sector Undertaking, wants to engage 1 Consultant (Electrical Engineering) on contract at Rajasthan Fields (RF), Jodhpur, and only retired officers of Grade C (Superintending Engineer) or above from OIL or another PSU under MoP&NG can apply. Applications in the prescribed format go by email to [email protected] on or before 23:59 hours of 05/12/2026 (Advertisement No. HRAQ/CONT-EX-B/26-317).

age_limit.details: The age of the applicant should not be more than 68 (sixty-eight) years as on the last date of receipt of application. The notice prints no age relaxation.

qualification.details: Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, OR Diploma of minimum 03 years duration in Electrical Engineering, as a full-time regular course from a Government recognized Institute/College/University/Deemed University. Minimum 25 years of working experience in any PSU under MoP&NG on permanent basis, out of which a minimum of 6/7 years in managing electrical engineering operations. Candidates with the requisite experience in liaison and administration will be given preference. During domestic official tours, a lump-sum daily allowance of ₹ 1,600/- per day will be extended. Travel, boarding and lodging and local conveyance on official tours outside the place of posting are as per the equivalent Grade of selection as Consultant. Paid leave of 10 (ten) days for every 06 (six) months on pro-rata basis, non-cumulative and non-encashable. Normal Company holidays of OIL apply. Applicable GST, if any, is extra and borne by the Company. Any other taxes are borne by the individual, and income tax as applicable will be deducted.

selection_process: Selection will be based on personal interaction with a Selection Committee. Shortlisted candidates will be informed through email about the mode of the personal interaction and its scheduled date and time. The notice does not give the interaction date.
important_instructions: The engagement is for 06 (six) months, extendable by another 06 (six) months up to a maximum of 01 (one) year depending on requirement of the Company. The incumbent works in line with regular officers and observes normal office timings. The Consultant may be called to attend office on weekly off days or holidays in case of urgency, with no additional payment. During the engagement the incumbent will not be allowed to take up assignment with any other Organization, Institution or Govt. agency. No TA/DA will be paid, and no reimbursement will be provided for joining. Accommodation must be arranged by the selected candidate.

content_sections.heading: About OIL
content_sections.text: Oil India Limited is described in the notice as a Maharatna Public Sector Undertaking and the second largest national upstream Oil & Gas company, with pan India presence and a global footprint. This engagement is for its Rajasthan Fields (RF) at Jodhpur.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the duly filled application form, in the prescribed format and with self-attested copies of the required documents, to the email id [email protected] on or before 23:59 hours of 05/12/2026. The notice does not print a subject line or a postal address. Use the application form printed on pages 4 and 5 of the notice (Application Form for Engagement as Consultant (Electrical Engineering) on Contract Basis at Rajasthan Fields (RF), OIL Jodhpur). Affix a recent passport size photograph on the form. Fill in personal details, educational qualifications and experience details. The experience section also asks for a write-up on relevant experience of maximum 300 words. Sign the declaration with date and place. Attach self-attested copies of the supporting documents listed under Enclosures. Email the application to [email protected] before the deadline. Give a valid e-mail ID and mobile phone number on the form. Applications in any format other than the prescribed one are summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, OR Diploma of minimum 03 years duration in Electrical Engineering, as a full-time regular course from a Government recognized Institute/College/University/Deemed University. Minimum 25 years of working experience in any PSU under MoP&NG on permanent basis, out of which a minimum of 6/7 years in managing electrical engineering operations. Candidates with the requisite experience in liaison and administration will be given preference. Must have retired at least from the post of Grade C (Superintending Engineer) or equivalent post from OIL or from any other PSU under MoP&NG. The age of the applicant should not be more than 68 (sixty-eight) years as on the last date of receipt of application. The notice prints no age relaxation. Knowledge of Rajasthan Fields installations and the challenges of remote locations. Familiarity with local administration, Border Security Force (BSF) and DISCOM processes and procedures. Strong technical knowledge of electrical engineering principles and practices, and good problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Effective communication and interpersonal skills to engage with stakeholders at various levels. Knowledge or understanding of the Rajasthani language and script may be an additional advantage. Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and meet deadlines, with a proactive mindset and the ability to adapt to changing circumstances. Monthly honorarium of Rs. 1,00,000/- is lump-sum and inclusive of local conveyance, telephone (landline/mobile), internet expenses etc., if any. During domestic official tours, a lump-sum daily allowance of ₹ 1,600/- per day will be extended. Travel, boarding and lodging and local conveyance on official tours outside the place of posting are as per the equivalent Grade of selection as Consultant. Paid leave of 10 (ten) days for every 06 (six) months on pro-rata basis, non-cumulative and non-encashable. Normal Company holidays of OIL apply. Applicable GST, if any, is extra and borne by the Company. Any other taxes are borne by the individual, and income tax as applicable will be deducted.

content_sections.heading: OIL Consultant (Electrical Engineering) Job Description
content_sections.text: The Consultant works at Rajasthan Fields (RF), Jodhpur. The notice calls this list indicative and not exhaustive. Technical Support: technical guidance and expertise to the Electrical Engineering Section for managing electrical installations, managing new projects and addressing technical issues. Coordination: liaise with local administration, DISCOM and BSF for timely support to installations in remote locations. Contract Management: oversee and manage services provided through contracts, ensuring required standards and objectives are met. Issue Resolution: work with the team to resolve electrical engineering operational issues, considering constraints of manpower and resources. Handholding and Training: assist new team members in understanding the complexities of managing RF installations. Documentation: maintain accurate records, reports and documentation on installations, technical issues and support provided. Compliance: ensure compliance with company policies, safety regulations and applicable industry standards. Continuous Improvement: identify areas for improvement in processes, procedures and resource utilisation and recommend changes. Stakeholder Engagement: collaborate with project managers, maintenance teams and other departments. Reporting: prepare periodic reports on the performance and activities of the Electrical Engineering Section. Other allied jobs as assigned by the concerned reporting Officer/HoD.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Proof of Date of Birth Proof of relevant experience/Education Qualification The documents must be self-attested copies. Applications without supporting documents for proof of date of birth, educational qualification and relevant experience will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on personal interaction with a Selection Committee. Shortlisted candidates will be informed through email about the mode of the personal interaction and its scheduled date and time. The notice does not give the interaction date.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is for 06 (six) months, extendable by another 06 (six) months up to a maximum of 01 (one) year depending on requirement of the Company. The place of posting is Rajasthan Fields (RF), OIL, Jodhpur, India. The candidate may be required to work at other locations as per Company's requirement/policy. The incumbent works in line with regular officers and observes normal office timings. The Consultant may be called to attend office on weekly off days or holidays in case of urgency, with no additional payment. During the engagement the incumbent will not be allowed to take up assignment with any other Organization, Institution or Govt. agency. No TA/DA will be paid, and no reimbursement will be provided for joining. Accommodation must be arranged by the selected candidate.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the OIL Consultant (Electrical Engineering) recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 (one) requirement for Consultant (Electrical Engineering) on contract basis at Rajasthan Fields (RF), OIL, Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed to [email protected] on or before 23:59 hours of 05/12/2026. Applications received after that time will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for OIL Consultant (Electrical Engineering)?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or a Diploma of minimum 03 years in Electrical Engineering (full-time regular course) is required. The candidate must also have retired at least from Grade C (Superintending Engineer) or equivalent in OIL or another PSU under MoP&NG.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is required?
faq.answer: Minimum 25 years of working experience in any PSU under MoP&NG on permanent basis, of which a minimum of 6/7 years in managing electrical engineering operations. Experience in liaison and administration gets preference.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age of the applicant should not be more than 68 (sixty-eight) years as on the last date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the OIL Consultant?
faq.answer: The monthly honorarium is Rs. 1,00,000/-, lump-sum and inclusive of local conveyance, telephone and internet expenses. A daily allowance of ₹ 1,600/- per day is paid on domestic official tours.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the OIL Consultant post?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed application form with a passport size photograph, attach self-attested proof of date of birth and of relevant experience/education qualification, and email it to [email protected]. Applications in any other format are rejected.

faq.question: Q8. How will the Consultant be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on personal interaction with a Selection Committee. Shortlisted candidates are informed by email about the mode, date and time.

faq.question: Q9. Is the OIL Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract engagement on consolidated honorarium for 06 months, extendable by another 06 months up to a maximum of 01 year depending on requirement of the Company.

faq.question: Q10. Will OIL pay travel allowance or joining expenses?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid and no reimbursement is provided for joining. Accommodation must be arranged by the selected candidate.
